title: Running `godot --headless --import` in a CI environment hangs on importing HDRis
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.6.stable, 4.5.1.stable, 4.4.1.stable, 4.3.stable

### System information

Arch Linux - Godot v4.6.stable - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce GTX 860M (nvidia, 590.48.01) - Intel® Core™ i7-4710HQ CPU @ 2.50GHz (8)

### Issue description

When trying to run `godot --headless --import` on a project the first time (no `.godot`) in a CI context (any computer without a display server, doesn't have to be a CI runner specifically), Godot gets stuck on importing any HDRis present in the project. The longest time I gave it to run was around 10 minutes. The reimport process also runs at 90-99% capacity for all 8 cores of my computer.

If the import has been run successfully before, for example on a different computer and `.godot` has been hard-copied to the CI computer, then the process runs fine and is near-instant. Running `godot --headless --import` also works from the CLI if the computer has a display server.

I tried Installing xorg and wayland on the CI computer (relating to #89767)
There are also no errors/warnings shown (even with `--verbose`) unlike in #92833

### Steps to reproduce

Steps to reproduce:
1. Clone MRP to a computer without a display server
2. Run `godot --headless --import`
3. The process hangs on importing `citrus_orchard_road_puresky_8k.hdr`


### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

MRP: https://github.com/SirLarion/godot-ci-hdr-reimport

(The project is 40MB zipped due to the large HDRi)
